Firewall_Port_List (object)
Declares a port-list for use by firewall rules. A firewall rule can match a packet’s source port or destination port against one of the ports in a port list, and can take some action (such as ACCEPT or DROP) for a matching packet.
Properties (* = required):
name
type(s)
default
allowed values
description
class*
string
“Firewall_Port_List”
label
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”
Optional friendly name for this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding a few likely to cause trouble with string searching, JS, TCL, or HTML
portLists
array
A list of other port lists (each by BIG-IP AS3 pointer or BIG-IP pathname).
ports
array
A list of ports and port ranges (for example, 80, “8080-8090”).
remark
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22x5cx7f]*$”
Arbitrary (brief) text pertaining to this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding only control characters, double-quote, and backslash.  This is permissive enough that you should worry about XSS attacks
